issues: 画面左上角打着调试标题「AXIAL STRETCH」，主体是三张 380×230 的灰条占位卡，内容读不出来
浅灰底 + 灰卡，没有光、没有层次，卡只占画面中部一条窄带，四周大面积空白
三张卡飞行距离不同，末卡拉丝明显弱于首卡；落点是软着陆，压扁回弹几乎看不见
卡片落定后整段静止，没有任何跟随动作，结尾帧不是一张完整的画面
changes: look 换成 lime（石墨底 · 荧光黄绿）：主体改为三块 540×470 的赛后数据砖 PACE 4:12 / DISTANCE 21.1 / HEART 152，168px 粗黑数字，104px 标题「Half marathon, done.」
拉伸仍由位置差分速度驱动（2→140px/f 映射到 scaleX 2.2 / scaleY 0.72，锚在后缘），每块统一飞 2000px，三块拉丝一样强；起飞间隔 10f→8f 越来越快
落点改为带余速撞停：飞行曲线末端留 ~12px/f，撞停帧切到以撞击面为锚的压扁（0.86 / 1.08），damping 14 弹簧弹回一次；砖内内容惯性前冲 18px 再被拉回
跟随与落位证据：空槽内凹 + 幽灵标签，撞停瞬间槽沿一圈荧光绿 ping、徽章计数 0→3 鼓一下；图表（配速柱 / 距离曲线 / 心电线）落定后 8f 才逐条画出
空间：舞台顶光 + 地平线光带 + 浮尘，砖下接触影随拉伸被抻长、飞得快离面高，地面 8% 倒影；hold 段极缓推镜 1→1.02，尾帧是完整的数据海报
issuesEn: A debug title "AXIAL STRETCH" sat at the top and the subjects were three 380×230 grey placeholder cards with nothing readable
Light grey stage and grey cards with no light or depth; the cards filled only a thin band in the middle of the frame
The cards travelled different distances, so the last one stretched much less than the first; landings were soft and the squash was barely visible
After the cards landed the shot froze with no follow-through, and the final frame wasn't a finished composition
changesEn: Lime look (graphite + neon yellow-green): three 540×470 post-run data tiles, PACE 4:12 / DISTANCE 21.1 / HEART 152, with 168px heavy numerals and a 104px headline "Half marathon, done."

Stretch is still driven by positional velocity (2→140px/f maps to scaleX 2.2 / scaleY 0.72, anchored at the trailing edge); every tile flies 2000px so all three stretch equally, launching 10f then 8f apart

Landings are now impacts: the flight curve keeps ~12px/f at arrival, then cuts to a squash anchored at the impact edge (0.86 / 1.08) and a damping-14 spring rebound; tile content overshoots 18px by inertia and is pulled back

Follow-through and slot evidence: recessed slots with ghost labels, a neon ping on the slot edge at impact, a 0→3 counter badge that bumps; the charts (split bars / distance curve / ECG) draw in 8f after landing
Depth: top key light, horizon glow and dust, a contact shadow that stretches with the tile, an 8% floor reflection, and a slow 1→1.02 push in the hold so the last frame is a finished data poster
